description: Weekly batch on Monday, 04:00–05:59 Europe/Madrid. The schedule is the window in which Renovate may create pull requests, not a start time, so it has to be wide enough for a hosted run to land inside it: a single hour was too narrow, and a whole-day window is noisier than intended.

packageRules.description: These security overrides must stay within their dependents' declared major ranges: undici@6 exists because @actions/http-client@4 declares undici: ^6.23.0; undici@7 because @semantic-release/github@12 declares undici: ^7.0.0; eslint@10.14.0, @eslint/config-array@0.23.5 and @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree@8.72.1 declare minimatch: ^10.2.x, and the minimatch override exists only because no fix exists in the 10.x line; conventional-changelog-writer@8.2.0/8.4.0 declare handlebars: ^4.7.7; cosmiconfig@9.0.2 declares js-yaml: ^4.1.0; @tailwindcss/node@4.3.5 declares source-map-js: ^1.2.1, while postcss@8.5.33 and tsup@9.0.0 declare ^1.2.2. Widening an override range to a new major pushes an unsupported major through a dependent that still declares the old one, so raise a major by hand together with the parent bump.
